summary: Converts three floats at this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8 (red, green, blue) into a packed 16-bit 5:6:5 colour. Each component is clamped to the [0,1] range, quantized to its bit depth with a +0.5 rounding offset (R and B scale by 31, G by 63), and the results are combined as (R<<11)|(G<<5)|B. A call to FPUControlWordMerger() controls the FPU rounding mode used during the float-to-int truncations.

operations.description: Clamp red at this+0x0: values below 0.0 are forced to 0.0, values above 1.0 are forced to 1.0, otherwise the value passes through unchanged
Clamp green at this+0x4: values below 0.0 are forced to 0.0, values above 1.0 are forced to 1.0, otherwise the value passes through unchanged
Clamp blue at this+0x8: values below 0.0 are forced to 0.0, values above 1.0 are forced to 1.0, otherwise the value passes through unchanged
FPUControlWordMerger() establishes the FPU rounding mode before the float-to-integer quantizations; the fill ties it to the FPU control-word store at dword_8B00A0
Quantize clamped red to 5 bits: floor(v6 * 31.0 + 0.5) where 31.0 is the 5-bit scale factor (flt_5ACCD0 per the fill)
Quantize clamped green to 6 bits: floor(v7 * 63.0 + 0.5) where 63.0 is the 6-bit scale factor (flt_5ACCD8 per the fill)
Quantize clamped blue to 5 bits: floor(v8 * 31.0 + 0.5) using the same 5-bit scale factor as red

Pack the three quantized components into one 16-bit 5:6:5 value: (blue) | ((green | (red << 6)) << 5), i.e. R occupies bits 11-15, G bits 5-10, B bits 0-4; used by TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing (005147ea)
